# rework claims — round 2 (deficiency_balance_resolution)
- R-ABSENT (P4 deficiency_ext_installment_settlement): the zero lump-sum clause is gone; an account with no lump-sum settlement offer dated today is outside the policy's schedules and takes the band minimum the base settlement rule sets (greater of min_installment_settlement_pct of the balance and settlement_floor_usd, never above the balance), stated in the rule next to the combination sentence and computed in `si_band_min`/`result`; the false proof sentence in task 1 §3 now holds over the whole domain, and edge_load_bearing / §8 / §9 / §11 were rewritten.
- R-ABSENT (P5 deficiency_ext_settlement_installment): the whole-balance clause is gone; with no accepted installment settlement the rule says the settlement rule allows no start and the installment is nil (0.00), consistent with base gate settlement_offer_accepted; the edge P5 <- P4 is re-declared state_gate (gate deficiency_settlement.settlement_offer_accepted) with rewritten effect, flips_to_true_by and skipped_effect; task 1 keeps one value_input edge (P4 <- P3).
- R-TIE (P4 si_lump_read, P5 ss_amount_read): "most recently recorded" (LATEST over created_at) replaced by "the largest such amount where the account carries more than one" (MAX), tie-free for rows recorded at the same clock; class sweep — no LATEST over created_at remains in the charter; P2, P4 and P5 now state the one-arrangement-in-force fact that makes LATEST over broken_date tie-free (P1 already did).
- R-MONTHEND (every whole-month sentence of P1-P5): the undefined "same day of a later month" gloss is replaced in every sentence by an explicit count — the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's — which is exactly the gate's MONTHS(); month-end probes recorded in plan.md.
- O2 (negative net recent counts, P2 and P5): the last tier now reads "any smaller count (none, or fewer once returns are taken off)" / "any smaller count", so every value has a tier.
- Observation (P3 sale ratio with a missing figure): the sale-recovery sentence now gives no points when either figure is missing, matching compute.
- Adversarial probe sweep over every read and edge of all five policies (prior / second / declined / reversed / absent rows, same-clock second offer and second acceptance, date difference 0, 90/91-day edge, month-end starts, negative counts, missing figures, floor above balance) run on scratch copies; table in plan.md and in each task's design_rationale §12; every outcome matches the rule words.
- O1, O3-O11, O-T1-1 and the CPI/dealer seed observations: no change (recorded as observations, not grounds for rework); gold write sequences, parameters and all factor weights of both tasks unchanged and re-verified by the gates.
